title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of P373M Grand Lotto jackpot on Nov. 16
summary: It was better luck next time for bettors of the Grand Lotto 6/55 whose jackpot now stands at over P373 million as no winners were announced in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on November 16,…

blocks.text: It was better luck next time for bettors of the Grand Lotto 6/55 whose jackpot now stands at over P373 million as no winners were announced in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on November 16, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Monday.
The Grand Lotto 6/55 prize for the 9 p.m. draw stood at P373,622,097.49. The winning numbers were 11-43-32-26-52-9.
The last time someone won the Grand Lotto 6/55
, when a lone bettor from Morong, Bataan won ₱115,358,791.87
For Megalotto 6/45, the combination of 13-22-41-43-26-45 would have meant a P22,331,155.54 windfall.
